products.name: Beamery
products.note: Talent lifecycle management AI; skills ontology; DEI analytics; UK-hosted; GDPR relevant

profile_text.body:
Beamery is a software company that describes itself as offering an AI-powered Workforce Transformation Platform aimed at enterprises. Its platform is designed to help organizations align talent strategy, plan workforce scenarios, and manage the full talent lifecycle, covering hiring, upskilling, and retention. The company emphasizes what it calls ethical AI and skills-based approaches, and its site references compliance standards, UK hosting, and GDPR relevance.

Beamery's core product suite includes a Workforce Intelligence Suite for scenario modeling and talent risk management, a Talent CRM with real-time AI-powered recommendations, and tools for sourcing and matching, talent marketing, career sites, and analytics. A central feature is Ray, described on the site as an embedded agentic AI consultant built to deliver context-aware recommendations and accelerate talent workflows. The platform also incorporates a skills ontology and DEI analytics, and the site notes integrations across existing HR systems.

The site cites Flex and Salesforce as enterprise customers. Flex is described as using Beamery to transform unstructured data such as job descriptions into a customized skills framework for more consistent candidate matching. Salesforce is described as using Beamery's integrated Talent CRM to improve hire quality and reduce data quality risks through real-time, skills-driven talent recommendations. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the held facts.
